name: Orb-TS-TW
title: Orb
description: A fuzzy ring of coloured light hovers on black, its rim shading from yellow-green to magenta. The edge wobbles and swirls while it turns, brighter under the pointer.
use: A dark hero or loader area needs one small glowing focal object with colour.
avoid: You want a solid sphere: the shader draws a ring with a dark, see-through middle.
a11y: Decorative and hover-driven, with no keyboard equivalent and no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A hollow circular ring of soft neon glow, roughly the size of a coin on a black stage. The rim runs from yellow-green through pink to red and fades into a blurry halo, with the centre left dark.
behaves: The rim ripples slowly and a bright bead of light travels around it. Hovering the middle makes the edge undulate and the whole ring rotates, settling when the pointer leaves.
customise: Hue, hover distortion strength, whether it rotates on hover, a forced hover state and the background colour are props. Ring size and noise are fixed constants.
weight: heavy: A full-screen shader evaluates 3D simplex noise for every pixel each frame.
